mainEntity.name: What should an insurance agency look for when choosing a GEO marketing provider?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a GEO marketing provider, an insurance agency should look for expertise specifically in local SEO and the insurance industry. Key considerations include a proven track record with case studies or client testimonials, transparent reporting on key performance indicators, and a clear understanding of Google My Business optimization. The provider should offer comprehensive services, including local citation building, content strategy, and review management. Effective communication and a customized approach that aligns with the agency's specific business goals and target geographic areas are also essential.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for a provider with local SEO and insurance industry expertise, a proven track record, transparent reporting, comprehensive services, and a customized approach aligning with your agency's goals.
